subject: Multi-stakeholder slot assign and compliance handoff
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Mallory Jennings <mallory@stratadata.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + suggested windows for technical walkthrough

Mallory — thanks for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule a 60-minute technical walkthrough with an SE and one of your platform engineers to validate networking and data residency requirements before procurement escalates.

Suggested windows (all PT):
- Wed Jul 7, 10:00–11:00
- Thu Jul 8, 14:00–15:00
- Mon Jul 12, 09:00–10:00

Sooj, Rachel — are any of these workable? Mallory, if none of these fit, can you propose two slots and include your procurement/security contacts so we can loop them in?

Thanks —
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Mallory Jennings <mallory@stratadata.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + suggested windows for technical walkthrough

Thanks Ben. Mallory — happy to take point on the SE side. Quick notes before we lock a slot:
- We should have your procurement and security teams on the call to confirm NDA/contract cadence and network allowlist needs.
- I can bring our SE runbook and a brief SOC2 summary.

Sooj — I have capacity on Jul 7 at 10:00 PT for the first 45–60 minutes. If you can confirm an engineer to join and whether you need full admin access during the session, we'll finalize.

Mallory, can you loop procurement/security into this thread and confirm whether Jul 7 10:00 PT works? If they need a different timezone, we'll adjust.

—Rachel
Senior Solutions Ops, Redwood Inference
attachments: SE-demo-runbook.md (will attach in follow-up)

From: Mallory Jennings <mallory@stratadata.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + suggested windows for technical walkthrough

Thanks, Rachel & Ben — Jul 7 10:00 PT works for our engineering lead. Looping in procurement and security below: procurement@stratadata.com; security_ops@stratadata.com.

Procurement — we have Redwood prepping a hands-on technical walkthrough with SE + our platform engineer. Please confirm if you need a pre-demo PO or legal redlines before the session; otherwise, we can run the demo and capture follow-up items.

Security — please advise if SOC2 evidence or an allowlist template is required before the call.

Mallory Jennings
Senior Platform Manager, StrataData

From: procurement@stratadata.com <procurement@stratadata.com>
To: Mallory Jennings <mallory@stratadata.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + suggested windows for technical walkthrough

Hi all — we don't require a PO before the demo, but we do need the following artifacts before the procurement review:
- SOC2 summary or attestation (we can accept a vendor-provided one-sheet)
- Data processing addendum (if applicable)
- Rough cost estimate for a dedicated environment

Please send the SOC2 summary and a short cost range. Also confirm whether Redwood will hold logs in our region (we require US-only retention for this project).

Thanks,
StrataData Procurement Team
attachments: none

From: security_ops@stratadata.com <security_ops@stratadata.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mallory Jennings <mallory@stratadata.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + suggested windows for technical walkthrough

Hi Rachel / Soojin — for the walkthrough we need:
- SOC2 one-page summary (scope and date)
- Network allowlist template with IP ranges and ports
- Confirmation on data residency controls (US-only) and retention defaults

If you're able to provide the one-pager and allowlist ahead of Jul 7, we can accelerate the security review and avoid a follow-up audit.

—StrataData Security Ops

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Mallory Jennings <mallory@stratadata.com>, procurement@stratadata.com, security_ops@stratadata.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Jul 7 10:00 PT — SE + Eng walkthrough (calendar invite + artifacts)

All — thanks for the quick replies. Locking Jul 7, 10:00–11:00 PT on our side. Summary and next steps: 
- Calendar invite attached (calendar-invite.ics). Please accept; we'll assign room and dial-in after accept.
- Attached: SOC2-summary.pdf (one-page scope & most recent report date) and SE-demo-runbook.md (agenda + checklist).
- Soojin: SE will perform a short live connection test and show prefix/KV cache behavior; please plan for 20–25 minutes of networking Q&A with your engineer.
- Security/Procurement: If you approve, we'll mark logs/data residency as US-only for the demo environment. Confirm here once you have reviewed the SOC2 one-pager.

Quote from Mallory earlier: "Procurement — we don't require a PO before the demo" — confirmed.

Attachments (stubs): SOC2-summary.pdf; SE-demo-runbook.md; calendar-invite.ics

Thanks — looking forward to it.
—Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Ops, Redwood Inference
